o: The total value of all open deals
Amount multiplied by probability, summed across open deals
The value of deals in Commit only
questions.e: Weighted value is amount multiplied by probability. It is the risk-adjusted view and is always smaller than raw open pipeline - and it excludes any deal with no amount or no probability.

questions.q: Which of these can you NOT do through the API on our version of the CRM?
o: Build a dashboard, star a favourite or reorder the sidebar
questions.e: Dashboards are read-only through the API on our version, and favourites and sidebar order cannot be set that way either. They have to be built by hand in the browser.

questions.q: Why is there no versus-target gauge on the dashboard?
o: The widget type is not supported
The Sales Target and Sales Transaction objects are empty
It was removed for being a vanity metric
questions.e: Both objects exist but hold no data, so there is nothing to compare against. Seeding targets is what would unlock a versus-target gauge and a pipeline coverage ratio.

questions.q: Which forecast category means 'keep tracking it, but leave it out of the numbers'?
questions.e: Omitted. Commit is essentially won, Best Case is winnable this period if things go our way, and Pipeline is real but earlier.
